whyItMatters: A default JAXP DocumentBuilderFactory resolves external entities, so a malicious XML document can read local files or probe internal network endpoints (XXE).
actions: Set http://apache.org/xml/features/disallow-doctype-decl to true right after creating the factory.
Alternatively set XIncludeAware(false) and ExpandEntityReferences(false) before newDocumentBuilder().
Re-run a SAST scan and confirm every flagged factory site carries the hardening flags.
verification: Every DocumentBuilderFactory creation site sets XXE hardening before parsing.
